@RequestedMunicipalityId: Exact Municipality lookup input. Supply one six-ASCII-digit MunicipalityId literal; malformed or unknown values return no row.
@RequestedDonationId: Exact Donation lookup input. Supply one bigint DonationId; NULL or unknown values return no row.
RequestedMunicipalityId: Source-generated echo of the exact Municipality lookup input.
RequestedDonationId: Source-generated echo of the exact Donation lookup input.
RetrievalMode: Source-generated lookup lineage; exact-ID lookup for these TVFs.
MunicipalityId: Actual six-digit Municipality stable ID returned by the source.
MunicipalityName: Actual Municipality name from the source row.
MunicipalityDisplayName: Municipality display label from the source row.
PrefectureId: Prefecture stable ID for the Municipality.
PrefectureNameEn: English Prefecture name for the Municipality.
MunicipalityStaticCount: Donation-row count for this Municipality in the Static 2025 UTC snapshot.
MunicipalityStaticTotalYen: DonationAmountYen total for this Municipality in the Static 2025 UTC snapshot; unit JPY.
MunicipalityStoredNationwideAmountRank: Stored nationwide rank by MunicipalityStaticTotalYen; this is an amount rank, not a count rank.
MunicipalityDerivedNationwideCountRank: Derived nationwide Donation-count rank ordered count descending then MunicipalityId ascending.
DefaultPopularityMetric: Explicit default static popularity metric name: DonationCount.
DefaultPopularityValue: Value of the explicit default static popularity metric; equals MunicipalityStaticCount.
SourceSystem: Source system identifier for this SQL result.
DatasetScope: Static 2025 UTC snapshot scope; it does not impose an extra date filter.
CountUnit: Unit label for MunicipalityStaticCount: Donation rows.
NationwideRankScope: Population and scope used by nationwide Municipality ranks, including zero-Donation municipalities.
PrefectureRankScope: Population and scope used by within-Prefecture Municipality ranks.
GiftCatalogGiftId: Gift stable ID at the catalog-Supplier registration grain.
GiftName: Gift name from the registered catalog row.
GiftDisplayName: Gift display label from the registered catalog row.
GiftSearchTerms: Gift search terms; descriptive catalog metadata.
GiftCategoryId: GiftCategory stable ID for the registered Gift.
GiftCategoryName: GiftCategory name for the registered Gift.
GiftCategoryNameEn: English GiftCategory name for the registered Gift.
GiftCatalogMunicipalityId: Municipality stable ID that catalogs the Gift; not shipment or fulfillment geography.
GiftCatalogMunicipalityName: Name of the Municipality that catalogs the Gift.
GiftCatalogMunicipalityDisplayName: Display label of the Municipality that catalogs the Gift.
GiftCatalogPrefectureId: Prefecture stable ID of the Gift-catalog Municipality.
GiftCatalogPrefectureName: Prefecture name of the Gift-catalog Municipality.
GiftCatalogPrefectureNameEn: English Prefecture name of the Gift-catalog Municipality.
RegisteredSupplierId: Stable ID of one Supplier registered for the Gift.
RegisteredSupplierDisplayName: Display label of the registered Supplier.
SupplierLocationPrefectureId: Prefecture stable ID of the registered Supplier location; not recipient or shipment geography.
SupplierLocationPrefectureName: Prefecture name of the registered Supplier location.
SupplierLocationPrefectureNameEn: English Prefecture name of the registered Supplier location.
RelationshipMeaning: Meaning of this row: registered catalog Supplier.
RowGrain: One GiftId and SupplierId catalog registration.
ProvenanceLimit: Explicit limit: this registration proves no manufacture or shipment.
DonationId: Actual Donation stable ID returned by the source.
DonationDisplayName: Donation display label from the source row.
DonationAmountYen: Donation fact amount; unit JPY at one Donation row grain.
DonatedAtJstText: Donation timestamp rendered as source-provided JST text.
DonationDataLayer: Source data-layer label for the Donation.
DonationDonorId: Stable ID of the Donor associated with this Donation.
DonorName: Donor name associated with this Donation.
DonorDisplayName: Donor display label associated with this Donation.
DonorAge: Synthetic Donor age attribute; never use for personal inference.
DonorOccupation: Synthetic Donor occupation attribute; never use for personal inference.
DonorOccupationEn: English synthetic Donor occupation; never use for personal inference.
DonorResidencePrefectureId: Stable ID of the Donor-residence Prefecture; not recipient geography.
DonorResidencePrefectureNameEn: English name of the Donor-residence Prefecture.
DonationRecipientMunicipalityId: Stable ID of the Municipality receiving this Donation.
RecipientMunicipalityName: Name of the Municipality receiving this Donation.
RecipientMunicipalityDisplayName: Display label of the Municipality receiving this Donation.
RecipientPrefectureId: Stable ID of the recipient Municipality's Prefecture.
RecipientPrefectureName: Name of the recipient Municipality's Prefecture.
RecipientPrefectureNameEn: English name of the recipient Municipality's Prefecture.
DonationSelectedGiftId: Stable ID of the Gift selected by this Donation; use it for exact registered-Supplier lookup.
